content:
I think this PR is entertaining: it's a nice speedup for linarith on large problems, by putting a syntactic level HashMap cache in front of a List based linear isDefEq lookup.

The PR is entirely conceived, implemented, and tested by AIs. My involvement started because I have an linear programming tactic implemented outside of Mathlib, that does both some quantifier elimination (i.e. it has a wider problem domain than linarith, although simultaneously narrower as it only works on Rat/Int/Nat problems), and that lp tactic turned out to be faster than linarith on large problems.

I then told the AIs "please go work out how to make linarith faster, so we have a fairer baseline", and then intermittently bullied and chastised them when they complained this was hard, and eventually they produced this PR...
